amendment_2026_09_06_before_any_signal.sensitivity: the same measurement is reported at caps of 50 and 250 so the choice is visible rather than load-bearing
amendment_2026_09_06_before_any_signal.what: manager_holdings_cap = 100, with sensitivity reported at 50 and 250
amendment_2026_09_06_before_any_signal.when: declared after inspecting the manager size distribution and before any information coefficient was computed; the cap is a property of the graph, not of the outcome
amendment_2026_09_06_before_any_signal.why: The original design said two issuers are connected if at least one manager holds both, and that is vacuous on 13F. Measured before computing anything: the three largest managers hold 9,125, 9,112 and 7,539 names, so with no cap nearly every pair of stocks is connected through an index fund and the connected-portfolio return collapses to the market return. Ali and Hirshleifer's analyst graph connects each stock to about 86 others, so a cap of 100 holdings is the closest analogue to attention at analyst scale. It keeps 52% of managers with a median of 40 holdings and covers 9,270 CUSIPs.

causality.enforcement: a quarter's holdings may only inform decisions strictly after the filing dates in that quarter's COVERPAGE
causality.rule: 13F is due 45 days after quarter end, so the point-in-time date is the FILING date and never the report date

cumulative_trial_warning: These 2 stack on every configuration searched across 257 recorded steps.

data.cost: free, no rate limit beyond SEC fair access
data.coverage: 53 files, 2013Q2 to 2026Q2, quarterly, roughly 70-95 MB compressed each
data.source: SEC Form 13F structured data sets, scraped from the official index rather than constructed by URL pattern because the naming changed in 2024
tables_used: COVERPAGE for the filing manager and the report period
INFOTABLE for issuer CUSIP, name and value held

design.connected_portfolio_return: equal-weighted lagged 4-week return of an issuer's connected set, excluding the issuer itself
design.connection: two issuers are connected in a quarter if at least one manager reports holding both
design.skip: one week between the signal and the forward return, as in Step 257
design.trials_note: 2 horizons x 3 caps; the caps are a sensitivity, but they are counted as trials because reporting the best of three would otherwise be a free search

hypothesis_from_literature: Ali and Hirshleifer, NBER 25201, find a value-weighted long-short on connected-stock past returns earning 1.19% a month at t = 6.71, where two stocks are connected if one analyst covers both. P2 in the queue is blocked because analyst identity needs the paid IBES detail file. The mechanism is shared attention and it does not have to be analysts: two stocks held by the same managers are watched by the same people. 13F is free. The declared sign is POSITIVE -- a stock whose connected portfolio rose should rise -- so a negative result is a failed replication, not a discovery.

identity_gate.gate: the CUSIP-to-cik10 match rate must be measured and reported before any signal is computed. Below 50% of the panel's issuers matched, the linkage graph is too sparse to trust and the experiment stops and says so.
identity_gate.precedent: Steps 210 and 211 found a present-day ticker file silently rewriting universe history. Identity joins in this project get measured, not assumed.
identity_gate.problem: 13F identifies issuers by CUSIP; this project's universe is keyed by cik10. There is no free official CUSIP-to-CIK crosswalk, so the join has to go through issuer names.

interpretation_fixed_in_advance.always: a cross-sectional IC is not a strategy, and a connected-portfolio signal is mechanically correlated with sector returns. Any survivor must be shown to beat a sector-matched control before it means anything.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_it_clears_in_selection_and_repeats_in: the first linkage signal in this project and the first candidate selected without seeing the window it is judged on; it still enters at the bottom of the gate list
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_nothing_clears_in_selection: the free linkage analogue does not reproduce the analyst effect on this universe; A0 closes and P2 stays a purchasing decision
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_the_identity_gate_fails: stop and record. The idea is untested, not refuted.

known_limitations_declared_up_front: 13F covers long US equity positions of managers above $100m only; it says nothing about shorts and nothing about small managers
holdings are quarterly snapshots, so intra-quarter trading is invisible
confidential treatment requests let managers omit positions, and those omissions are not observable
question: Do stocks held by the same institutional managers predict each other's returns, the way stocks covered by the same analysts do?
why_it_matters_here: Every family this project has tested is a transform of prices or of reported numbers. Step 245 measured 1.57 effective independent strategies; Steps 246, 248, 250, 256 and 257 closed eleven candidate families. A linkage signal is the one shape in the literature that is neither a price nor a fundamentals transform, which is the only reason this is worth four gigabytes.
